name: FA_MC_CONVERSION_RATES
description: FA_MC_CONVERSION_RATES contains exchange rate information to convert assets from primary to reporting books during MRC Asset Transactions Upgrade. When you run Phase 1 of the MRC Asset Transactions Upgrade, this table will store all the assets that will be converted. Once Phase 1 is complete you can provide a CONVERSION_BASIS of either R or C to convert each asset. If you provide R as the basis, you will have to provide an exchange rate to use for conversion or use the default rate as defined in the GL conversion options. If you provide a conversion basis of C, you will have to provide the COST of the asset in the reporting currency. PRIMARY_CUR_COST reflects the COST of the asset in the primary book and you should not update this column. STATUS column is used during Phase 2 of the upgrade and will reflect CF or CL once Phase 2 is complete.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of currency conversion for transactions.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Total recorded cost of the asset.

columns.name: PRIMARY_CUR_COST
columns.description: Cost of an asset in the primary currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Rate used for converting amounts between primary currency and reporting currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_BASIS
columns.description: Basis for converting transaction amounts from primary ledger currency to the reporting currency.

columns.name: LAST_PERIOD_COUNTER
columns.description: Last period asset depreciated in primary book at time of reporting conversion.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the capital or operating lease.
